pages.title: ArborFirmaCraft Forests
pages.text: When ArborFirmaCraft is installed, TFE integrates its additional tree species into the newer forest generation. The compatibility content stays disabled without AFC and does not create a hard dependency.

pages.title: Trees and Climate
pages.text: The compatibility pack contains 45 ordinary AFC forest tree entries and selects species using temperature, groundwater, rainfall variation, and elevation. Their current elevation range is -64~320.

pages.title: Coordinated Forest Data
pages.text: When AFC is installed, TFE coordinates both mods' tree lists, tree shapes, and large forest features, reducing truncated giant trees, missing species, and misplaced humus.
